text:
marta (PM): looping everyone in — Tempest Systems (mid-market logistics) just asked for a private on-prem deployment in an air-gapped datacenter. timeline: aiming for 8 weeks. requirements listed: HSM/KMS integration, no external egress, offline installer, SOC2+country-specific data residency. can product triage?
liam (Sales): +customer is ready to sign if we can meet 8 weeks and cert the HSM. they asked for pricing estimate for Dedicated vs Private later today.
devon (Solutions Eng): quick Qs — which HSM vendor? tempest mentioned Thales and AWS CloudHSM as options. also: do they need our console or purely local control plane?
marta (PM): they want control plane on-prem too — minimal external control plane traffic. HSM vendor TBD but they said they prefer a FIPS-validated HSM.
sasha (Infra): blockers: network egress rules, jumpbox for installs, airgap packaging for runtime images, and verified drivers for chosen HSM. estimate infra prep ~3-4w if we have datacenter access.
kai (Security): need KMS/HSM integration design + key escrow policy review. also export control and export licenses might apply depending on HSM vendor. i'll need customer SOC2 report and network diagram.
liam (Sales): i'll collect SOC2 + network diagram today, ask customer about preferred HSM vendor.
marta (PM): propose initial prioritization: Intake -> Feasibility spike -> Ops runbook -> Implementation. Candidate priority: P2 (customer is high ARR but not yet enterprise contract). we can do P1 if legal signs expedited SLA.
devon (Solutions Eng): feasibility spike checklist (quick):
```
- confirm HSM vendor + driver compatibility
- confirm airgap install path + offline signer
- list required firewall/IP allowlist for installer
- define control-plane sync windows (if any)
- validate DB encryption at rest with managed KMS/HSM
- required entitlements for support & remote debugging
```
sasha (Infra): adding infra tasks:
```
- pre-stage images onto local registry (airgap)
- provide install runbook and offline bootstrap script
- arrange physical access / bastion schedule with customer
- verify GPU/CPU availability (model sizes)
```
marta (PM): launch criteria (initial):
- successful airgap install in customer staging
- HSM keys generated & integrated, round-trip encrypt/decrypt test
- perf smoke: infer latency within agreed SLO on sample workload
- documented rollback & telemetry hooks
- signed network & legal checklist

kai (Security): must-have: KMS integration design, KATs for key rotation, audit log export to customer SIEM (no external S3).
liam (Sales): customer asked for an on-site install window — they prefer week-of-May-12. client will provide network creds and SOC2.
devon (Solutions Eng): rough effort estimate: feasibility spike 1w (2 engineers half-time), infra prep 3w, implementation 3w, security signoff 1w. aligns with an 8-week total if nothing blocks.
marta (PM): OK. next steps: 1) liam to upload SOC2 + network diagram into RDW-4382 (private-intake), 2) devon to run feasibility spike and confirm HSM vendor compatibility by +5 days, 3) sasha to draft airgap install runbook template, 4) kai to list security signoffs. i’ll schedule a scoping call for tomorrow 11am PT.
liam (Sales): uploaded docs to RDW-4382. pinged customer for HSM vendor preference.
devon (Solutions Eng): starting the spike now — will post findings in RDW-4382 thread.
sasha (Infra): drafting runbook, will share stub by EOD.
kai (Security): adding required checklist items to RDW-4382/security.
deploy-bot: RDW-4382 created by marta — assignees: devon, sasha; priority: P2; due: 1900127900.
marta (PM): thanks everyone — we'll use this thread for quick notes. if blockers pop, escalate to eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
